Fragrance should live with you, not compete with the room.

02 / Our story

Made with attention. Designed to stay.

WRAPPED.CO started with a simple idea: home fragrance can feel special without feeling precious. The design is restrained, the scent is considered, and every detail has a reason to be there.

Based in Worcester, Massachusetts, we are developing our first small-batch collection for homes that favor warmth, texture, and a little quiet.

03 / Candle care

A better burn starts with the first light.

01Set the first burn

Let the wax melt evenly to the edge of the vessel on the first burn. This helps prevent tunneling later.

02Trim the wick

Before each use, trim the wick to about 1/4 inch. A shorter wick helps the candle burn evenly and keeps the flame controlled.

03Know when to stop

Do not burn a candle for more than four hours at a time. Stop using it when about 1/2 inch of wax remains.

Stay close
